remarks: Welcome to 190 Seaton Road #1A, a beautifully maintained first-floor condominium in the desirable Second Fairlawn complex of Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood. Offering easy one-level living, this bright and inviting unit is ideal for both owner-occupants and investors alike. Inside, you'll find a rare open-concept kitchen and living room layout with wood floors throughout, creating a comfortable flow for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features ample cabinetry, a pantry, and island dining space, while the sun-filled living area offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The bedroom is situated directly across from the spacious bathroom featuring a jacuzzi tub, with excellent closet space throughout the unit. A standout feature is the direct rear access leading to assigned parking space #8, the common laundry area behind Building 182, and the included private storage unit located in the basement of Building 190. The complex also offers plenty of guest and visitor parking. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges. Conveniently located just down the street from I-95 and minutes to Metro-North, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, parks, and more. A fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking comfort, convenience, and value in a commuter-friendly location.
